newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South China floods kill at least 25 people - paper.
newsitem.headline: South China floods kill at least 25 people - paper.

text.p: At least 25 people have died in floods near the southern Chinese city of Guangzhou, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Thursday.
Torrential rain battered much of southern Guangdong province on Wednesday, marking the start of the annual rainy season.

At least 11 people in one town drowned when flood waters destroyed 3,500 houses. Another 30,000 were trapped by the rising water. A further 14 people in a nearby town died when a river broke its banks.
